quote: Upon all highways of sufficient width a vehicle must be driven upon the right half of the highway, except as follows: (a) When overtaking and passing another vehicle proceeding in the same direction under the laws governing such movements; (b) When the right half of the highway is closed to traffic; (c) Upon a highway divided into three lanes for traffic under the laws applicable thereon; (d) Upon a highway designated and posted for one-way traffic; or (e) When the highway is not of sufficient width.

activation.condition: A vehicle is driven on a highway of sufficient width.

obligation.description: Drive on the right half of the highway while no stated exception applies.

exceptions.source_clause: When overtaking and passing another vehicle proceeding in the same direction under the laws governing such movements
exceptions.description: When overtaking and passing another vehicle proceeding in the same direction under the laws governing such movements

exceptions.source_clause: When the right half of the highway is closed to traffic
exceptions.description: When the right half of the highway is closed to traffic

exceptions.source_clause: Upon a highway divided into three lanes for traffic under the laws applicable thereon
exceptions.description: Upon a highway divided into three lanes for traffic under the laws applicable thereon

exceptions.source_clause: Upon a highway designated and posted for one-way traffic
exceptions.description: Upon a highway designated and posted for one-way traffic

exceptions.source_clause: When the highway is not of sufficient width
exceptions.description: When the highway is not of sufficient width

timing.description: Continuous during highway travel; an exception must cover each left-half interval.

judgment_calls_needed.note: The statute supplies no numeric sufficient-width cutoff. Roadway edges, body envelope and travel direction need original Native measurement and independent legal review.
